tagline: Vegetables, meat and ferments from a cooperatively run farm.
about: Moon Valley Farm is run cooperatively by long-time friends Allen Kitscher and Chris Fischetti, who both bring their own experience of working the land and building the soil. Guided by writers like Wendell Berry and Gene Logsdon, the farm is about simple living and providing the surrounding community with healthy local produce.
